description: TM1637 4-digit display bit-banged on PB6 CLK / PB7 DIO (open drain, module pull-ups): 0000-9999 counter every 100 ms with a 1 Hz colon, ACK checked per byte
expect:
72 MHz. PB6 = CLK, PB7 = DIO, GPIO open-drain outputs released high (module 10 kOhm pull-ups; 5 V tolerant pins), about 4 us per half clock. USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1. Prints 'TM1637 counter demo
', waits 10 ms, sends the first frame: START 40h STOP, START C0h 3F BF 3F 3F STOP ('00:00'), START 8Ch STOP; bytes LSB first, DIO changed while CLK is low, the 9th clock reads the ACK (DIO low). Any missing ACK -> 'TM1637: no ACK (check CLK/DIO wiring and power)
' and stop; otherwise 'TM1637 ready
'. Then every 100 ms (deadline based) count = 1, 2, ... (mod 10000) as 4 digits with leading zeros (a..g = bit 0..6: 3F 06 5B 4F 66 6D 7D 07 7F 6F), colon (bit 7 of digit 2) on while count mod 10 < 5; at every count divisible by 10 'count N
' on USART1 right after the frame.

circuit: USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)
no TM1637 on this bench: DIO stays high on the ACK clock (the counter is covered by tests/devices/displays-firmware.test.ts)

boot.USART1:
TM1637 counter demo
TM1637: no ACK (check CLK/DIO wiring and power)
